2. Enable OAuth 2.0 (Native App) with callback URL:
en.login_developer_steps_suffix: 3. Paste the Client ID in Settings > Developer API. No rebuild is needed.

en.settings_account_desc: Manage account information, password, data archive and signed-in accounts.
en.settings_api_desc: Use an app created in your own X Developer Portal.
en.settings_api_intro: Use an OAuth 2.0 Native App created in your own X Developer Portal. Once saved, sign-in and all live API requests use this configuration, which remains only on this device.
en.settings_api_developer_url_hint: Long press the address to copy it, then open it in a browser.
en.settings_api_redirect_uri_hint: Add this address under your app's OAuth 2.0 Redirect URI. Long press to copy it; choose Native App and enable the read/write permissions you need.
en.settings_api_secret_note: Native apps use PKCE. Do not enter a Client Secret here. Changing the Client ID signs out the current account.
en.settings_api_save_failed: Could not save API configuration. Try again.
en.settings_security_desc: Manage account security and connected apps.
en.settings_privacy_desc: Manage audience, content, muting, discoverability and data sharing.
en.settings_notifications_desc: Control automatic notification checks and the unread dot.
en.settings_accessibility_desc: Manage how Harmony X displays content.
en.settings_resources_desc: Find product, help and service information.
en.settings_accessibility_intro: Manage text size, color and language preferences.
en.settings_grip_hand_desc: Move the floating compose button for the hand holding your device.
en.settings_language_intro: Choose the language used throughout Harmony X. Changes apply immediately and are kept next time you open the app.
en.settings_language_system_desc: Use the system language throughout Harmony X.
en.settings_language_zh_cn_desc: Use Harmony X in Simplified Chinese.
en.settings_display_intro: Manage text size, color, and background.
en.settings_app_icon_desc: Choose the icon shown on the home screen and in app lists.
en.settings_app_icon_intro: Pick an icon for Harmony X. The home screen, app list and recent apps all follow it.
en.settings_app_icon_note: Icons ship with the app, so nothing has to be downloaded. You can always switch back to the default.
